mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (product_id, location_id,quantity_on_hand) VALUES (#{productId}, #{locationId}, #{quantity}) ON CONFLICT (product_id,location_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity_on_hand = inventory.quantity_on_hand + EXCLUDED.quantity_on_hand, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT inv.inventory_id, inv.product_id, inv.location_id, inv.quantity_on_hand, inv.updated_at, p.sku, p.description AS product_description, l.location_code FROM inventory inv JOIN product p ON p.product_id = inv.product_id JOIN location l ON l.location_id = inv.location_id ORDER BY p.sku, l.location_code
